scientific_conclusion: The exact Stage-81 ordinate maps recombine to the Stage-85 pair maps to 1.48e-16 relative L2, and the retained minmod reconstruction has exactly zero boundary-cell slopes. Consequently, the boundary-upwind second-order correction is exactly zero at the wall-adjacent interior face while the same component supplies at least 98.3769% of the first-interior grouped norm. The surviving non-boundary-upwind wall-to-first ratio remains at least 0.970780, so it is retained rather than discarded. This establishes a structural frozen-stencil explanation for the abrupt near-wall suppression, but it does not establish that the boundary treatment is wrong, does not recover the failed Stage-28 MUSCL solver, and does not imply that q_av would improve after a solver change.
positive_findings: Pair reconstruction closes to 1.48e-16 relative L2 and all four frozen reconstruction implementation invariants pass.
Boundary-upwind wall-face correction is exactly zero, while its first-interior component accounts for at least 98.3769% of the grouped first-interior norm.
negative_findings: The structural zero-slope finding is diagnostic and does not prove a numerical boundary error or benchmark improvement.
Non-boundary-upwind directions remain active and are explicitly retained.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and cross-Knudsen extension remains prohibited.
No physical, collision, correction-floor, source-relaxation, transport, wall, normalization, or velocity-quadrature parameter was retuned, and no cavity solver was rerun.
